text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're losing speed, Desire! Is that all 
your legs are good for?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Impure thoughts only cloud a Saint's 
soul. I must cast them aside...—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*..., *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey! How much longer are you gonna keep 
running so half-assedly, Desire?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...My mind was wandering. Even though you 
were running alongside me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll run tandem with you as much as you 
want. As long as it snaps you back to your 
usual sharp self, that is."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Look, I don't wanna see you running like 
some uncool loser."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You've always run looking further into the 
distance than anyone else, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone said, she kept her 
head held high, staring straight ahead at 
a finish line she couldn't even see, and 
just ran.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've always seen you as someone 
special.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That she's just as cool, tackling races 
from the exact same eye level as me!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san... You were... watching me, 
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Not merely tracing the outline, but 
pouring this soul dwelling within me into 
it..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I wouldn't have come this far, 
would I?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Desire. Thinking is fine and 
all, but right now is the time to run.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Just 'cause Buena's going overseas 
doesn't mean anything's changed about your 
own dream, right?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... of course. I am headed... to the 
Other World—...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Is that a dream you can't achieve without 
a rival?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A rival isn't just some tool to add flavor 
to your own little story.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I have someone like that too, so I get it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Going head-to-head with her is the 
absolute most fun, and it makes me want to 
beat her no matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still... the one whose back I'm chasing 
isn't his.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've just been chasing after the back of 
my dream.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is running their own life, 
chasing after their dreams. Just like I'm 
running mine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"That's just it! Not someone else's, but 
your own! With these legs! With this soul! 
Only those who run it through to the end—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna reach a badass world that 
nobody's ever seen before!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Paving the way... on one's own feet...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Red Desire?! Are you 
really okay staying looking this uncool?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: !? V-Vodka-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...S-Sorry. I got a little carried away...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: N-No...! Please, take my hand...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Vodka suffered a heavy 
nosebleed. She wasn't injured, nor was she 
flushed—it was completely out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: It is the 'Crimson Wedge'.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san has developed the 'Crimson 
Wedge.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Red Desire called the "Crimson Wedge" 
was a rare condition that occasionally 
affects those who pursue pure speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It occurs when internal pressure on the 
trachea, lungs, or nasal capillaries 
exceeds its absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once developed, it frequently recurs, 
sometimes forcing long periods of 
recuperation in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, it didn't seem to be anything 
serious, but... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I shall remain by Vodka-san's side for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words carried a quiet intensity that 
brooked no argument.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I truly appreciate your understanding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since then— and 
today, Red Desire is diligently looking 
after Vodka once again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire's dedicated demeanor was truly 
that of someone bearing a sacred mission—
choice_data_list:
(Still... we have to get back to 
training.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Vodka's condition seems stable for now, 
but there's no telling when the bleeding 
might start again.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"As a Saint... I must offer my utmost 
devotion."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She surely understands that if she aims 
for the Shuka Sho, she cannot afford to 
come to a standstill here.
choice_data_list: (But... can I deny it? Her decision.)
(But... can I deny it? Her decision...)

text_block_list.text:
...Are you going to stop in your tracks 
here?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Saint Red Desire... Is this where your 
journey ends?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-san...! B-But, Vodka-san drove in the 
'Crimson Wedge'—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...You should walk your own path. No 
matter who it is, or what happens... keep 
looking straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Cafe-san...—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What you call the "Crimson Wedge" is proof 
that an Umamusume has pushed beyond her 
absolute limits...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A sort of sign... engraved only onto those 
who have approached the ideal land and 
knocked on its door.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...A code word?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is the proud wedge borne by those 
who are 'too fast.'

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Desire-san, please don't ever forget.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You are the Saint Red Desire, who seeks 
the "Otherworld."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Not ordinary... A chosen existence capable 
of sensing the unseen.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...That is precisely right."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"If one claims the name of a Saint, they 
must be prepared to bear every blessing... 
and every curse bestowed upon them."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Stopping in our tracks here is one 
answer... however."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Doing that will never allow you to reach 
it. —"That distant place."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I am... The Chosen Saintess, Red 
Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In order to reach "that place," I've run 
through this path of trials up to now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: And from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're fine just the way you are.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about me! There's no way I'm 
stopping in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So what if I got a nosebleed? Here, look, 
it's completely healed already!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I told you, Desire. I will keep running 
for myself, and myself alone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you've got a place you're aiming for, 
then you run just for yourself, too!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even while bleeding for the sake of her 
mission, Vodka-san keeps her eyes fixed 
ahead—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
How naive I was. How terribly immature I 
was...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Without someone by my side, or rather... 
Halting my steps just because of someone 
else— that is something that must never 
happen...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The tale of Saint Red Desire can only be 
completed by running it through on these 
very legs of mine, and yet—!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone... the cloudiness in my 
soul has been wiped clean.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships may plague me 
from here on out... my legs will not stop.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Until we reach the alternate world, we 
must never waver, look only ahead, and 
sprint on with all our might.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I shall prove with a victory in the Shuka 
Sho that I will continue to run with the 
pride of a Saint—!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! I'm countin' on seein' 
you run cool as hell!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Our preparations to reach "that place" are 
coming together. That's the spirit, 
Desire...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Due to my own shortcomings, I have caused 
everyone a great deal of trouble.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To make up for falling behind, please 
subject me to the most rigorous trials 
during the remaining days!
choice_data_list:
Forge an indomitable spirit through 
long-distance swimming.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Now! Hah—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Please watch closely, everyone...! The 
run of an awakened Saint—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(At the 'Shuka Sho,' the majestic figure 
of the Saint Red Desire, wrapped in 
glorious radiance!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having cut through all hesitation, Red 
Desire began running once more on her own 
two feet. Her figure looked brilliant, 
brimming with energy.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer! There is no stopping me now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Toward the place I am destined to reach, 
with single-minded—determination!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Long-distance swimming... A lonely, 
extreme training where there's nowhere to 
run—...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... there was never any escape to 
begin with. The only path for me is the 
one leading to the "Otherworld".)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(I will without fail conquer the Shuka 
Sho—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Seize the shining light of glory—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished her long-distance swim, 
Red Desire stood against the setting sun 
with a refreshed smile... looking 
breathtakingly radiant.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Facing myself amidst the silence... 
it feels as if mana is welling up from the 
depths of my being.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu... Tomorrow, I expect an even 
greater ordeal than today. I shall be in 
your care.
